This mod reworks analog lever from create, stepped lever from design 'n' decor, crank from supplementaries. To be like throttle lever from create:aeronautics. cranks works differintly but you still can easily choose your redstone signal

您安裝每個 mods 時可以搭配 Lever drugster

本模組有可選下載項目：supplementaries，create，design 'n' decor，create:connected，create compact gearbox transmisson

design 'n' decor 在 1.20.1 中無法運作（問題不在我方）
